name: [PILOT] Gemini Meeting Notes Coordinator (Apps Script delivery)

nodes.name: Gemini Notes Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Bind a service mailbox credential. This is only a cheap first-pass filter; the calendar series allowlist is authoritative.

nodes.name: Get Full Gemini Email
nodes.notes: Bind the same Gmail OAuth credential. The email supplies the Doc URL; the Doc remains the notes source.

nodes.name: Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate
nodes.notes: Prototype/variable-free identity gate. Gmail subject and Doc ID are the source-of-truth inputs; Calendar is intentionally not required in this flow.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { repo: 'ElishaSamPeterPrabhu/modus-wc-2.0', branch: 'main', docId: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docId, docUrl: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docUrl, meetingType: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.title, meetingDate: $('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.meetingDate, reviewId: `meeting-${$('Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate').item.json.docId}-${Date.now()}`, reviewProxyUrl: 'https://script.google.com/a/macros/trimble.com/s/REPLACE_APPS_SCRIPT_ID/exec', source: 'Gemini meeting notes' } }}

nodes.name: Call Cursor Meeting Intake
nodes.notes: Cursor reads the Doc and private repository, builds the review card, and POSTs {reviewId, items, chatResponse} to reviewProxyUrl. n8n ends after this call.

main.node: Apply Meeting Identity and Idempotency Gate
